content: Imthong ampraekhaih
To ahmuen to a caehtaak moe, Jordan vapui yaeh Judea prae ah caeh: to naah anih khaeah paroeai kaminawk angzoh o let; a sakzong ih baktih toengah kaminawk to patuk let bae.
Farasinawk anih khaeah angzoh o moe, Kami maeto mah a zu pakhrak han daan oh maw? tiah anih tanoekhaih lok a dueng o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Mosi mah tih lok maw ang paek o?

content: tiah pathim pae.
Nihcae mah, Mosi mah loe kami maeto mah zu pakhrak hanah, zu pakhrakhaih ca to tariksak, tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Palung na thah o pongah ni anih mah hae baktih poekhaih hae ang tarik pae o.
Toe tangsuek naah Sithaw mah, nongpa hoi nongpata to sak.
Hae pongah nongpa mah amno hoi ampa to caehtaak ueloe, a zu hoiah om tih.
To naah nihnik loe takpum maeto ah om hoi tih: to pacoengah nihnik loe kami hnetto ah om hoi ai boeh, taksa maeto ah ni oh hoih boeh.
To pongah Sithaw mah nawnto patomh boeh loe, mi mah doeh tapraek hmah nasoe.

content: Imthung ah oh o naah, a hnukbang kaminawk mah hae kawng pongah anih khaeah lokdueng o let.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Mi kawbaktih doeh a zu to pakhrah moe, kalah zu to la nahaeloe, a zu laep ah daan ai ah zaehaih sah kami ah oh.
Nongpata mah a sava to pakrah moe, kalah nongpa to la nahaeloe, a sava laep ah daan ai ah zaehaih sah kami ah oh,

content: tiah a naa.
Jesu mah nawktanawk tahamhoihaih paek
Anih suisak hanah, nawktanawk anih khaeah angzoh o haih: a hnukbang kaminawk mah nawkta hoi kaminawk to zoeh o.
Toe to tiah sak o ih hmuen to Jesu mah hnuk naah, palung hoih ai pongah nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Nawktanawk to kai khaeah angzo o haih ah, haek o hmah: Sithaw ukhaih prae loe to baktih kaminawk han ih ni oh.
Loktang kang thuih o, Mi kawbaktih doeh Sithaw ukhaih prae to nawktanawk baktiah talawk ai kami loe, a thungah akun thai mak ai,

content: tiah a naa.
Anih mah nawktanawk to ban ah tapom tahang moe, nihcae nuiah a ban to koeng pacoengah, tahamhoihhaih to paek.
Angraeng thendoeng

Anih loklam ah caeh naah, kami maeto anih khaeah cawnh hoiah angzoh moe, khokkhu cangkrawn pacoengah, anih khaeah, Patukkung kahoih, dungzan hinghaih ka hnuk hanah, timaw ka sak han? tiah lok a dueng.
Jesu mah anih khaeah,

content.text: Tipongah kahoih, tiah nang kawk loe? Sithaw khue ai ah loe mi doeh hoih ai.
Daan ai ah zu sava laep ah zaehaih sah hmah, Kami hum hmah, Paqu hmah, Hnukung amsawn ah om hmah, Minawk aling hmah, Nam no hoi nam pa to saiqat ah, tiah thuih ih kaaloknawk to na panoek to loe,

content: tiah a naa.
To kami mah anih khaeah, Patukkung, hae hmuennawk loe ka nawkta nathuem hoiah ni ka pazui boih boeh, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih to khet, anih to palung pongah, anih khaeah,

content.text: Maeto angai vop: Caeh ah, na tawnh ih hmuennawk to zaw boih ah loe, kamtang kaminawk hanah paek ah, to tiah nahaeloe van prae ah qawk na tawn tih; to pacoengah angzo ah, thinglam to apu ah loe, na bangah,

content: tiah a naa.
Anih mah to lok to thaih naah, anih loe hmuenmae paroeai tawn kami ah oh pongah, palungset moe, a caeh ving.
Jesu mah a taeng ih kaminawk to khet moe, a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah,

content.text: angraeng kaminawk Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah uk ih prae thungah akun hanah kawkruk maw rai!

content: tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kaminawk loe a thuih ih lok pongah paroeai dawnrai o. Toe Jesu mah nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Nawktanawk, long angraenghaih oep kaminawk loe Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah uk ih prae thungah akun hanah kawkruk maw rai! tiah pathim pae let.
Long angraeng maeto Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah uk ih prae thungah akun pongah loe, kaengkuu hrang phungvang khaw thungah akun han zoi kue,

content: tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae loe dawnrai o moe, to tih nahaeloe mi maw pahlong ah om thai tih? tiah a thuih o.
Jesu mah nihcae to khet moe,

content.text: Kami hanah loe angcoeng thai ai, toe Sithaw hanah loe angcoeng thai ai hmuen tidoeh om ai: Sithaw hoiah loe hmuen boih angcoeng thaih,

content: tiah a naa.
To naah Piter mah anih khaeah, Khenah, kaicae loe, hmuennawk to ka caeh o taak boih moe, na hnukah ka bang o, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah, Loktang kang thuih o,

content.text: Kai hoi tamthanglok hoih pongah, imlawk, nawkamya, tanuh, amno, ampa, a zu, a caanawk hoi lawknawk caehtaak kami loe,
pacaekthlaekhaih tongh o cadoeh, vaihi atue roe ah imnawk, nawkamyanawk, tanuhnawk, amnonawk, a caanawk, lawknawk to alet cumvaito ah hnu tih; angzo han koi atue ah loe dungzan hinghaih to hnu tih.
Toe hmahman kaminawk hnukkhuem o ueloe, hnukkhuem kaminawk hmahman o tih,

content: tiah a naa.
Jesu mah a duekhaih kawng thuicoek

Nihcae loe Jerusalem bangah caeh o tahang; to naah Jesu loe nihcae hmaa ah caeh: a hnukbang kaminawk loe dawnrai o; anih hnukah bang o naah, nihcae loe zit o. Anih mah kami hatlai hnettonawk to kawk moe, a nuiah kaom han koi hmuen to thuih amtong pae.

content.text: Khenah, aicae loe Jerusalem ah a caeh o; kami Capa to kalen koek qaima hoi ca tarik kaminawk khaeah paek o tih; nihcae mah anih to dueksak hanah lokcaek o ueloe, anih to Gentelnawk khaeah paek o tih:
nihcae mah anih to pahnui o thuih ueloe, bop o tih, anih to tamtui hoiah pathoih o ueloe, anih to hum o tih: toe anih loe ni thumto naah angthawk let tih,

content: tiah a naa.
Jakob hoi Johan mah hnikhaih
Zebedi ih caa hnik, Jakob hoi Johan loe, anih khaeah caeh hoi moe, Patukkung, ka koeh hoi ih hmuen nang sak pae hanah koehhaih ka tawnh hoi, tiah a thuih pae hoi.
Anih mah nihnik khaeah,

content.text: Tih saksak han ih maw na koeh hoi?

content: tiah a naa.
Nihnik mah anih khaeah, Na lensawkhaih thungah phak naah, na bantang bangah maeto, na banqoi bangah maeto anghnut hanah na paek ah, tiah a naa hoi.
Toe Jesu mah nihnik khaeah,

content.text: Nang hnik hoi ih hmuen to na panoek hoi ai: ka naek ih boengloeng hae na nae hoi thai tih maw? Kai tuinuemhaih hae na nuem hoi thai tih maw?

content: tiah a naa.
Nihnik mah anih khaeah, Ka nuem hoi thai tih, tiah pathim pae hoi. Jesu mah nihnik khaeah,

content.text: Ka naek ih boengloeng hae na nae hoi ueloe, kai tuinuemhaih to na nuem hoi thai tih:
toe ka bantang bang hoi ka banqoi bangah anghnut han ih loe ka paek han koi hmuen na ai ni; to anghnuthaih ahmuen loe paroep pae tangcae ih kaminawk hanah ni oh,

content: tiah a naa.
To lok to haatonawk mah thaih o naah, Jakob hoi Johan nuiah palung hoih o ai.
Jesu mah nihcae to angmah khaeah kawk moe, nihcae khaeah,

content.text: Gentel ukkungnawk loe angmacae Gentel kaminawk nuiah angraeng ah oh o, tito na panoek o; kalen kaminawk mah nihcae to koeh baktiah uk o.
Toe nangcae salakah loe to tiah oh han om ai: mi kawbaktih doeh nangcae salakah kalen koekah oh han koeh kami loe, nangcae ih toksahkung ah om nasoe:
mi kawbaktih doeh kalen koekah oh han koeh kami loe, nangcae boih ih tamna ah om nasoe.
Kami Capa loe minawk toksaksak hanah angzo ai, minawk ih tok to sak pae moe, paroeai kaminawk akrang hanah a hinghaih paek han ih ni angzoh,

content: tiah a naa.
Bartimaeus ih mik amtueng

To pacoengah nihcae loe Jeriko vangpui ah angzoh o: anih loe a hnukbang kaminawk, pop parai kaminawk hoi nawnto Jeriko vangpui thung hoiah tacawt naah, Timaeus capa, Bartimaeus, tiah ahmin kaom mikmaeng loe lam taengah anghnut moe, ban patueng.
Anih mah to kami loe Nazareth vangpui ih Jesu ni, tiah thaih naah, nang David capa, Jesu, kai hae na tahmen raeh, tiah a hangh.
Minawk mah anih to anghngai duem hanah a zoeh o: toe anih mah, nang David capa, kai hae na tahmen raeh, tiah kanung aep ah a hangh.
Jesu loe angdoet moe,

content.text: anih to kawk oh,

content: tiah a naa. To naah nihcae mah mikmaeng to kawk o, anih khaeah, Poek kanawm ah om ah loe, angthawk ah; Anih mah ang kawk, tiah a naa o.
Anih mah angmah ih kahni to vah sut moe, angthawk tahang pacoengah, Jesu khaeah caeh.
Jesu mah anih khaeah,

content.text: Timaw saksak han na koeh?

content: tiah a naa. To naah mikmaeng mah, Angraeng, mik amtueng hanah ka koeh, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah,

content.text: Caeh lai ah; na tanghaih mah ang hoisak boeh,

content: tiah a naa. Akra ai ah a mik to amtueng pae roep, to pacoengah loklam hoiah Jesu hnukah a bang.
